bootstrap.method: Percentile 95% crossed/product bootstrap. Sort the 5 session IDs and the 100 global dialogue IDs. For each replicate, one random.Random(20260901) stream draws 5 sessions with replacement and then 100 dialogues with replacement. Every original session-by-dialogue cell receives Cartesian-product multiplicity m_s*n_d, and all conditions in that cell retain the same weight (pairing). Point estimates use the unweighted complete 5x100 grid. Percentiles use the same linear interpolation as analyze.py: position=(n-1)*p between adjacent sorted draws.
bootstrap.condition_pairing: all conditions retain each sampled session-dialogue cell weight m_s*n_d
